name: SAND Base OFT delegate-confused-deputy bridge drain
summary: OFTSand exposed an unrestricted approveAndCall callback whose first-argument check did not constrain the callback target, selector, or authority used by the callee. Calling the LayerZero Endpoint through OFTSand therefore made the Endpoint see the OFT itself as msg.sender and let an unprivileged caller replace the OFT's configuration delegate. This is an executed confused-deputy defect in the direct OFTSand runtime, not a compromised credential or an initially unsafe configured parameter.
notes: Direct OFTSand creation. Archival Base code is empty in block 17735348, appears in creation transaction 0xc55651bcf7dc996f8bced152804b12064ee3a0be1cc5d6b37b225860491da39b at block 17735349:69, and hashes to 0xda4a757532c7d0a1bc3aecbc814f4b09a1786d0f35fb40d08fd5bca38ddfbaeb both at deployment and immediately before the incident. Verified source has no proxy, beacon, facet, or mutable code-selection path.

Exact pre-recovery gross depletion is the sum of 15 SAND Transfer events from Ethereum OFT adapter 0xac531eb26ca1d21b85126de8fb87e80e09002dcf. Each receipt's OFTReceived event identifies LayerZero source EID 30184 (Base); the set starts 150 seconds after the Base takeover and ends at 2026-08-22T01:22:11Z. The exact raw sum is 14753431668978000000000000 wei-SAND. Nominal unbacked Base mint amounts, attacker swaps, and later unrelated withdrawals are excluded. DefiLlama's nearest high-confidence Ethereum SAND observation was $0.04648630455127788 at 2026-08-22T01:20:00Z, 131 seconds before campaign end.

The Sandbox's promised full technical report was not yet published at review time. Its initial statement says Ethereum reserves remained intact but does not reconcile the onchain adapter releases and near-zero post-campaign adapter balance.
This Base incident owns the 15 Base-origin Ethereum escrow releases and does not assign nominal unbacked token supply a loss value.

The same OFTSand address on BNB Chain has a different immutable-bearing runtime hash and a separate successful delegate-takeover anchor. That chain is excluded pending evidence of at least $1,000 actual depletion; loss is not duplicated here.
